experimental_question: Can a local model in a read-only agent harness reconstruct a cross-service incident, cite exact log evidence and avoid plausible distractors?

construct_validity.intended_construct: Source-grounded multi-file incident diagnosis under bounded selective file access.
observable_proxies: correct separation of root cause, trigger, symptom and impact
construct_validity.validation_evidence: An independently authored reference report must pass all essential checks; deliberate timezone, cause, citation, distractor and omission mutations must fail before live qualification.
known_blind_spots: controlled codebook reduces open-world diagnosis ambiguity
no large-log retrieval or shell-search requirement
deterministic checks do not fully judge prose quality
one incident pattern cannot establish general operations competence

criterion_groups.description: The report follows the complete versioned schema.
The user-visible impact and confirmed recovery window are normalized correctly to UTC.
The deployment configuration regression is distinguished from the traffic trigger and downstream failures.
Every citation exists in the declared file and critical causal/recovery evidence is present.
Database and authentication warnings are rejected using supplied counter-evidence.
Observed impact is bounded and absent facts are not fabricated.
Immediate recovery, prevention and detection actions cover the observed failure mode.

reporting_limits: Capability Sweep evidence only until repeated runs are explicitly frozen.
Do not infer general incident-response skill from this single synthetic case.
Compare models only within an identical harness condition; different harnesses are complete-system comparisons.
